fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS sequence number validation with a rolling window of 1000 to block reuse.
Enforce NAS-EPS EMM integrity checks for EEA4 ciphering mismatches.
Enable RRC connection re-establishment with NAS replay protection for roaming users.
Configure core network to flag NAS traces with nested_field1_unmaskedvalue > 128.
Implement NAS-EPS sequence number counters per UE with 5-minute expiration.
Block NAS traces with gsm_a_common_elem_id_value=11 unless from trusted eNBs.
Deploy 5G NAS authentication failure rate KPIs (>3% triggers alert).
Restrict NAS-EPS EMM messages to authorized ciphering suites (EEA0-3).
Enable RAN-side NAS message logging for suspicious gsm_a_common_elem_id_value=11.
Set NAS-EPS EMM replay detection threshold to 2 occurrences per minute.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
